title: AAE alumna and Blue Origin vice president Powers featured in 'Relentless' video series
summary_en: Audrey Powers, vice president of mission and flight operations at Blue Origin, shares how overcoming challenges as a student helped her entire career.

title: ME's Malshe leads first ever In-Space Manufacturing class
summary_en: To sustain operations in space, you have to be able to build in space. That’s the idea behind the first ever university course focused on In-Space Manufacturing — hosted by the Cradle of Astronauts, Purdue University.
title_cn: ME's Malshe leads first ever In-Space Manufacturing class

title: Purdue engineers unlock key to combining exceptional strength with plasticity in advanced structural material
summary_en: In a paper published in Science Advances, Purdue University engineers demonstrated a way to achieve simultaneous high strength and plasticity in cobalt aluminum (CoAl) intermetallics.
title_cn: Purdue engineers unlock key to combining exceptional strength with plasticity in advanced structural material

title: ECE's Bhave wins 2026 Wen Ko Technical Leadership Award
summary_en: Sunil Bhave, professor in Purdue University’s Elmore Family School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, has received the 2026 Wen Ko Technical Leadership Award from the Transducer Research Foundation.
title_cn: ECE's Bhave wins 2026 Wen Ko Technical Leadership Award

title: From Pune to Purdue: Ananya Anand Nadkarni engineers smarter systems
